evidence: To demonstrate the ability of our workflow to resolve cell type specific proteomes within human brain tissue, we isolated sets of individual Betz and Purkinje cells.

we hypothesized that Betz and Purkinje cells are morphologically, topographically, and functionally so distinct that they would serve as an ideal testbed for the demonstration of proof-of-principle for our LCM-based microproteomics method development.
we isolated sets of individual Betz and Purkinje cells.
identified on average 3551 and 2874 proteins... from the Betz cell and Purkinje cell fractions, respectfully (n = 3).
